# 3Dconnexion browser SDK

`3dconnexion.min.js` is the unmodified 3DconnexionJS 0.7.0 browser adapter retrieved from `https://3dconnexion.com/technical_support/3dconnexion.min.js` on 2026-09-03.

SHA-256: `a11b78252aebc0ebd1cd5e4b14f9f2a87a1bf7ee552dd9e0507342548a7551d0`

The file retains 3Dconnexion's copyright and Software Development Kit license notice at its head. Serving this adapter locally avoids a runtime CDN dependency; it connects only to the browser computer's 3DxWare bridge. The nurb camera, focus, and connection adapter lives in `src/nurb/spacemouse.js`.
